rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Container — Imagine a container whose lock, size, material, and location feel credible. Secure Pending — breathe naturally.
2. Place Cannot — Place only what cannot be processed now inside it.
3. Name Stored — Name what is stored and when it will be revisited, ideally with support. Secure Pending — name sensation.
4. Close Container — Close the container and reorient to the next task for today. Secure Pending — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Close Container.

rituals.hook: Spot: A believable refuge works better than fantasy pressure.
rituals.recognition_cue: Spot: A believable refuge works better than fantasy pressure.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Place Five → Rehearse Specific → Strengthen
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Place Five → Rehearse Specific → Strengthen
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Trauma & memory-as-present

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Spot: A believable refuge works better than fantasy pressure.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A believable refuge works better than fantasy pressure.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Place Five → Rehearse Specific → Strengthen
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Place Five — Construct a place using five sensory facts and one control feature: an exit, boundary, companion, or adjustable distance. Build Safe — move slowly.
2. Rehearse Specific — Rehearse entering through a specific cue and leaving on purpose. Build Safe — name sensation.
3. Strengthen — Strengthen the detail that produces the clearest bodily yes. Build Safe — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Strengthen.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Strengthen cleared.

MY RESULT
A believable refuge works better than fantasy pressure.
rituals.my_result: A believable refuge works better than fantasy pressure.

rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Apply Quiet → Use Word → Name Producing
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Values, meaning & loss

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Spot: Name enough to see; not enough to build a story.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Name enough to see; not enough to build a story.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Apply Quiet → Use Word → Name Producing
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Apply Quiet — As events arise, apply a quiet category: hearing, planning, heat, remembering, pressure. Word Light — hear sound.
2. Use Word — Use one word once, then return to the raw event. Word Light — allow opposite.
3. Name Producing — If a Name starts producing analysis, Name that ‘explaining’ and release it. Word Light — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Name Producing.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Name Producing cleared.

MY RESULT
I just separated 'not enough right now' from 'never enough.'

rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Choose Precise → Track Interval → Let Practice
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Pause: Meditative flow is repaired one break at a time.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Meditative flow is repaired one break at a time.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Choose Precise → Track Interval → Let Practice
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Precise — Choose an anchor and notice the precise moment contact breaks. Close Micro — widen gaze.
2. Return Instead — Instead of judging the distraction, shorten the delay before returning.
3. Track Interval — Track the interval between noticing and reconnection. Close Micro — notice detail.
4. Let Practice — Let practice end after one stretch with visibly fewer or shorter gaps. Close Micro — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Let Practice.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Let Practice closed.

MY RESULT
Meditative flow is repaired one break at a time.

rituals.trigger_play_time:

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Pick Word → Flash Image → Jump Letter
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Pick Word — Choose one harmless five-letter word, such as TABLE. Use each letter once; there is no need to finish perfectly. Break Night — feel support.
2. Call Object — For the first letter, name a neutral object beginning with it—T for tree, for example.
3. Flash Image — Picture that object for about two seconds with no action, meaning, memory, or story. Break Night — allow opposite.
4. Jump Letter — Jump to the next letter and a completely unrelated object. End after five letters; do not score sleep. Break Night — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Jump Letter.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Jump Letter worked.

MY RESULT
Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.

1. See The Person — Imagine the person in front of you. Say Mind — loosen hands.

3. Do Not Edit — Let the message be honest, but do not plan harm. Say Mind — notice detail.

rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Set A Time — Choose up to twenty minutes. Twenty Minute — widen gaze.

3. Come Back To Now — End by naming your location, today’s date, and one caring action you can take. Twenty Minute — allow opposite.
4. Repeat Only If Helpful — Try again on another day only if it helps. Twenty Minute — next action.

rituals.plain:
THE TWENTY-MINUTE TRUTH STORY

TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Check: A private story can help your mind make sense of an event.

GOAL
A private story can help your mind make sense of an event.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Set A Time → Come Back To Now → Repeat Only If Helpful

1. Set A Time — Choose up to twenty minutes. Twenty Minute — widen gaze.
2. Tell The Story — In your mind, move through what occurred, what you felt, and what it means now.
3. Come Back To Now — End by naming your location, today’s date, and one caring action you can take. Twenty Minute — allow opposite.
4. Repeat Only If Helpful — Try again on another day only if it helps. Twenty Minute — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Repeat Only If Helpful.

WIN SIGNAL
Repeat Only If Helpful clicked.

MY RESULT
A private story can help your mind make sense of an event.

FORMULA FLOW
Set A Time → Tell The Story → Come Back To Now → Repeat Only If Helpful

rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Picture Prediction → Imagine Line → Remove Vote
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Twist: A forecast should lose influence when its decision window closes.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A forecast should lose influence when its decision window closes.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Picture Prediction → Imagine Line → Remove Vote
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Picture Prediction — Picture the prediction and the exact condition that makes it obsolete: date passed, result known, action completed, evidence changed. Cross Out — soften shoulders.
2. Imagine Line — When that condition arrives, Imagine a line through the forecast and Picture EXPIRED. Cross Out — add counterfact.
3. Remove Vote — It may remain historically visible, but it receives no further vote. Cross Out — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Remove Vote.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Remove Vote landed.

MY RESULT
A forecast should lose influence when its decision window closes.

rituals.play_the_loop:

3. Stamp Simulation — When repetition yields no new preparation, stamp the simulation PAID IN FULL and switch to execution. Turn Anticipation — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Stamp Simulation.

Stamp Simulation closed.

rituals.title: THE LIFE RETURNED TEST
rituals.name: THE LIFE RETURNED TEST
rituals.hook: Shift: Imagine receiving this ordinary day back.
rituals.recognition_cue: Shift: Imagine receiving this ordinary day back.
rituals.goal: Imagine receiving this ordinary day back.
rituals.mission: Imagine receiving this ordinary day back.
rituals.challenge: Imagine receiving this ordinary day back.
rituals.immediate_need: Imagine receiving this ordinary day back.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Picture → Small → Choose Behaviour
rituals.unique_game_move: PLAY: Picture → Small → Choose Behaviour
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Shift: Imagine receiving this ordinary day back.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Imagine receiving this ordinary day back.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Picture → Small → Choose Behaviour
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Picture — Picture having lost access to your current life and unexpectedly waking inside it again. Life Returned — widen gaze.
2. Small — What small feature would suddenly matter—someone’s voice, a body ability, unfinished work, morning light?. Life Returned — notice detail.
3. Choose Behaviour — Choose one behaviour that honours that recovered value today, without romanticising real hardship. Life Returned — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Behaviour.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Choose Behaviour settled.

MY RESULT
I can imagine receiving this ordinary day back.
rituals.my_result: I can imagine receiving this ordinary day back.
rituals.formula_flow: Picture → Small → Choose Behaviour
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Avoid loss imagery if it worsens grief, trauma, or suicidal thinking.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

PLAY: Name Options → Warning → Choose Visible
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name Options — Name the two or three live options. For each, Picture the specific way it could fail—not a vague fear. Choose Easiest — breathe naturally.
2. Name Failure — Name the earliest observable sign that failure has begun. It must be visible or clear, not a feeling alone.
3. Warning — State what corrective action would still be available when that sign appears and what cost has already accumulated. Choose Easiest — name feeling.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Visible.

PLAY: Choose Simple → Place Reality → Let Relationship

items.hook: Zoom: Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.

items.game_move: PLAY: Pick Word → Flash Image → Jump Letter
items.unique_game_move: PLAY: Pick Word → Flash Image → Jump Letter
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Zoom: Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Pick Word → Flash Image → Jump Letter
items.play_the_loop:
1. Pick Word — Choose one harmless five-letter word, such as TABLE. Use each letter once; there is no need to finish perfectly. Break Night — feel support.
2. Call Object — For the first letter, name a neutral object beginning with it—T for tree, for example.
3. Flash Image — Picture that object for about two seconds with no action, meaning, memory, or story. Break Night — allow opposite.
4. Jump Letter — Jump to the next letter and a completely unrelated object. End after five letters; do not score sleep. Break Night — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Jump Letter.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Jump Letter worked.

MY RESULT
Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.
items.my_result: Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.
items.formula_flow: Pick Word → Call Object → Flash Image → Jump Letter
items.safety:
PAUSE
Use only while safely resting; never while driving. Stop if images become distressing, compulsive, or disorienting.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

HOOK

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A throwaway mistake can make the first move lose its authority.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Throwaway → Fix One → Continue Clean
items.play_the_loop:
1. Throwaway — Open a private mental sandbox and mark it THROWAWAY—NOT FOR SENDING. Make First — feel support.
2. Make Wrong — Imagine one obviously imperfect start: a clumsy first sentence, rough title, messy mental sketch, or unfinished opening.
3. Fix One — Correct exactly one useful part without polishing the rest. Make First — allow opposite.
4. Continue Clean — Keep working only if the task now feels editable; otherwise keep the corrected fragment in mind and stop cleanly. Make First — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Continue Clean.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
Continue Clean shifted.

items.safety:
PAUSE
Never use deliberate errors in medical, legal, financial, safety-critical, submitted, or live shared work.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

GOAL
Judge the mental move by how it treats your life.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Ask Thought → Leave Me → Thank Warning
items.play_the_loop:
1. Ask Thought — Ask the current thought three questions: Does it clarify the next move?. Ally Saboteur — press feet.
2. Check Protection — Does it protect something real?
3. Leave Me — Does it leave me more capable afterward?. Ally Saboteur — pick action.
4. Score Yes — Score each yes or no.
5. Thank Warning — If it fails two, thank the warning and appoint a different inner adviser. Ally Saboteur — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Thank Warning.

HOOK

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Some mental worlds persist through continuous subscription.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Identify Image → Let Existing → Redirect
items.play_the_loop:
1. Identify Image — Spot the image, conclusion, or demand being refreshed. Stop Renewing — feel support.
2. Time — For one minute, refuse only the renewal: no new scene, argument, or confirmation.
3. Let Existing — Let existing residue fade at its own rate. Stop Renewing — name sensation.
4. Redirect — Redirect the freed attention into a chosen sensory task. Stop Renewing — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Redirect.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Define — Set the exact external behaviour required. Precise Outside — soften shoulders.
2. Execute — Execute it with full timing and skill.
3. Imagine Applause — Meanwhile, decline the running argument about authorship, resentment, or imagined applause. Precise Outside — notice detail.
4. Let Body — Allow the body act and the inner courtroom remain closed until the task ends. Precise Outside — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Let Body.

items.play_the_loop:
1. See The Person — Imagine the person in front of you. Say Mind — loosen hands.
2. Say What Happened — In your mind, say what happened, what you felt, what you needed, and what you now choose to release.
3. Do Not Edit — Let the message be honest, but do not plan harm. Say Mind — notice detail.
4. Wait — Do not contact the person for twenty-four hours. Let the message stay only in your mind. Say Mind — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Wait.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Peek: Language can lower heat without lowering truth.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Language can lower heat without lowering truth.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Underline → Observe Behaviour → Read Action
items.play_the_loop:
1. Underline — Underline absolutes and inflammatory terms in your account. Cool Words — feel support.
2. Observe Behaviour — Exchange every one for a precise factual equivalent: ‘always’ becomes the actual frequency; ‘destroyed’ becomes the specific loss; ‘evil’ becomes the observed behaviour. Cool Words — name sensation.
3. Read Action — Re-read and notice what action the cooler version supports. Cool Words — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Read Action.

TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
Catch: Absence becomes evidence only after prediction says what should be present.

GOAL
Absence becomes evidence only after prediction says what should be present.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Ask Sign → Mark Absence → Name Explanation

1. Ask Sign — Ask what sign must exist right now if the feared model is correct. Look Missing — soften shoulders.
2. Search Fairly — Search once, fairly.
3. Mark Absence — If it is absent, Keep that absence and reduce—not erase—the model’s weight. Look Missing — notice detail.
4. Name Explanation — Name the alternate explanation strengthened by the missing sign. Look Missing — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Name Explanation.

WIN SIGNAL
Name Explanation shifted.

MY RESULT
Absence becomes evidence only after prediction says what should be present.

FORMULA FLOW
Ask Sign → Search Fairly → Mark Absence → Name Explanation

items.play_the_loop:
1. Set Level — At three intervals, Keep not only level but direction and speed: rising fast, steady, falling slowly. Measure Emotion — soften shoulders.
2. Add Action — Add the action impulse at each point. Measure Emotion — name feeling.
3. Make Decisions — Make decisions from trajectory plus facts, not from the first intensity number alone. Measure Emotion — next action.

GOAL
Emotion maintains itself through tempo as well as story.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Cadence → Choose Opposite → Observe Emotional
items.play_the_loop:
1. Cadence — Notice the cadence of speech, movement, or breathing. Change Rhythm — soften shoulders.
2. Choose Opposite — Choose an opposite rhythm: agitated becomes deliberate, collapsed becomes lightly brisk, looping becomes irregular. Change Rhythm — notice detail.
3. Observe Emotional — Maintain the new tempo through one simple task and observe the emotional shift. Change Rhythm — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Observe Emotional.

1. Name Appears — When ‘I’m lazy,’ ‘I’m unlovable,’ or another global Name appears, demand three specific behaviours from the last month that support it and three that complicate it. Global Labels — press feet.

GAME MOVE

items.play_the_loop:
1. Identify Object — Spot the first object the desired behaviour requires. Put First — move slowly.
2. Position — Position it where normal movement will encounter it at the right time.
3. Remove Competing — Remove competing cues from that path. Put First — pick action.
4. Meet — When you meet the object, perform the linked first action before walking past. Put First — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Meet.

HOOK

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A safer choice may be the mistake you can see early enough to correct.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Name Options → Warning → Choose Visible
items.play_the_loop:
1. Name Options — Name the two or three live options. For each, Picture the specific way it could fail—not a vague fear. Choose Easiest — breathe naturally.
2. Name Failure — Name the earliest observable sign that failure has begun. It must be visible or clear, not a feeling alone.
3. Warning — State what corrective action would still be available when that sign appears and what cost has already accumulated. Choose Easiest — name feeling.
4. Choose Visible — Choose the option whose reliable warning arrives while correction is still practical. Use this as one decision criterion, not the whole verdict. Choose Easiest — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Visible.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Shift Weight — Stand safely and shift weight slowly left, centre, right, then forward and back. Find Moment — move slowly.
2. Identify Instant — At each transition, spot the exact instant the receiving foot supports you. Find Moment — name sensation.
3. Finish Centre — Finish at centre and name the strongest contact point. Find Moment — next action.

GAME MOVE
PLAY: Mask Names → Rank Blind → Reveal Options
items.play_the_loop:
1. Mask Names — Ask someone—or a shuffled Notice—to rename the leading options A, B and C without showing which is which. Hide Option — soften shoulders.
2. Choose Traits — Choose three relevant traits, such as cost, time, fit, reliability, or learning. Keep safety facts visible.
3. Rank Blind — Compare the symbols on those traits without guessing their identities and Hold the current order. Hide Option — split forecast.
4. Reveal Options — Reveal the names. Keep the blind order or name exactly what Name changed it and why. Hide Option — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Reveal Options.
items.win_reward:

Reveal Options held.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Sort By Mind Mode — Group tasks into simple types such as talking, reading, errands, decisions, or admin. Group By — feel support.
2. Make One Block — Put tasks that use the identical kind of attention together. Group By — notice detail.
3. Finish The Block — Complete that block before changing to a different kind of task. Group By — next action.
